# Rekordly

> Rekordly is a free, open-source Windows desktop app that monitors
> content creators, automatically records their live streams, downloads
> videos and VODs, and organizes everything into a searchable local library.

Rekordly watches the creators you follow across supported streaming sites,
hits record the moment they go live, and files every capture into a
searchable local library. Recording is a lossless straight copy powered by
bundled yt-dlp and ffmpeg — nothing else to install. The app is local-first:
no account, no telemetry, all data stays in SQLite on your machine. Free and
open source under the Apache License 2.0, including commercial use.

Supported platforms: Twitch, YouTube, Rumble, Kick, Chaturbate, Stripchat,
BongaCams, Cam4, CamSoda, Jerkmate, Streamate, MyFreeCams, and Dreamcam —
with a Tango Live plugin available from the marketplace — extensible to any
site through the community plugin system and its typed SDK.

- [Home](https://rekordly.in/): product overview, features, FAQ, and download links
- [Features](https://rekordly.in/features): every feature in detail
- [Download](https://rekordly.in/download): installer and portable builds for Windows 10/11
- [Plugins](https://rekordly.in/plugins): the plugin system and how to build a site plugin
- [Plugin Marketplace](https://rekordly.in/marketplace): browse all site plugins and request support for a new site
- [Adult live stream recording](https://rekordly.in/adult-stream-recording): using Rekordly to monitor and automatically record live streams from supported live-cam platforms
- [Blog](https://rekordly.in/blog): guides and product notes
- [Roadmap](https://rekordly.in/roadmap): shipped, in-progress, and planned work
- [Contact](https://rekordly.in/contact): bug reports, feature requests, and general inquiries
